cases.query: What is the correct SQL syntax for an UPSERT operation in PostgreSQL?
contexts:
PostgreSQL UPSERT Syntax (INSERT ON CONFLICT):

```sql
INSERT INTO users (id, email, name, updated_at)
VALUES (1, 'user@example.com', 'John Doe', NOW())
ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
  email = EXCLUDED.email,
  name = EXCLUDED.name,
  updated_at = NOW();
```

Key components:
- ON CONFLICT (column): Specifies the unique constraint column
- DO UPDATE SET: Specifies columns to update on conflict
- EXCLUDED: References values from the attempted INSERT
- DO NOTHING: Alternative to skip the row on conflict
